george.line: I want to be transparent here, George:
stanza: I want to be transparent here, George:
I'm not the greatest fan of your religion
And I personally believe that those
Who cover up abuse should go to prison

george.songTitle: Sunday in the Park with George
george.line: Sunday in the park with George
stanza: Sunday in the park with George

george.line: That is not like you, George
stanza: That is not like you, George

gorge.line: A rock slide echoes across the gorge
stanza: And after our talk I saw the wall of rock as a wave in the middle of breaking
A rock slide echoes across the gorge
And who am I but a blink of the eye?
A stance that a river would take
If it even wanted to pause
